page.layout: One page of running text, with marginal notes in the left margin. No headings, no notes below the text, no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: toftum aduerfus calculum, dyfenteriam & toxica, Miracu- lum na- tura, Taurorum & aprorum fibris refertior eft, & quia taurorum fanguis celerrime coit, & durefcit, inter potus peftifera recens, praefertim habitus eft potus. Hircorū tanta vis praedicatur, vt ferramentorum fubtilitas non aliter acrius induretur, fcabritia collatur vehementius, Arcanu. quam lima. Quin & inquicta illa vis adamantis, rerum violentiffimarum ferri & ignis contemtrix, hircino fanguine rumpitur, calido ac recenti. Unde remediis aduerfus calculum recte admifcent medici.

Caprinum celebrauit Homerus: gallinarum quoque & columbarum, & potiffimum faginatarum à quibusdam edi compe- rio, qui tum fuauitate, tum coctionis facilitate eum commendant : Leporinus cum iecore caeterifque visceribus elixatur. Quocumque autem modo praeparaueris fanguinem, inuenies eum vtplurimum concoctioni contumacem effe & excrementofum. Turrum fanguinis tribus gutturis puero exhibitis, epileptico auxiliari, experimentis indubitatis patefactum eft: Vulnerandus autem tem leuiter alter pes eft, fanguifque excipiendus. Non conticendum, Hippocratem negare fanguinem effe calidum contra Sanguis Hippocratis non eft calidus. opinionem, rationem affert hanc, quod in animali mortuo calorem non retineat,

page.notes: Left margin notes are set in a small italic type, partly cut off at the edge. Their wording is read from the scan and may be partly wrong: "Miracu- lum na- tura" and "Arcanu." are doubtful, as are the notes near "Sanguis" and "Hippocra-tis". The text is badly blurred in places, so several words are read with low confidence and carry no [?] marks here; the line "Hircorū" and the passage ending "retineat" in particular should be checked. Long s is copied as a plain s. The paragraph break before "Caprinum" is inferred from the indent. Some words of the second half are uncertain and have not been marked with [?].
